lane: Backend AI router + SQL + Admin overview: measure real AI cost per feature (P1-C)
goal: Measure the real AI cost of every model call per feature so the future Nil price list can be calibrated: a dated, sourced reference price book with verified/unverified flags for every default and fallback model; cost, tokens and cost_source (reported|estimated|unknown) on every generation span, success or failure; a read-only aggregate RPC (UTC+7 day, feature, model; p50/p95/p99; error/fallback/estimated rates; per-user-day distribution without user ids) for ai.read and service_role; and a 'Chi phí AI' block on Admin Tổng quan. Routing, fallback order and budget values do not change. Nothing is applied or deployed by the agent.
successCriteria: provider-registry.ts: REFERENCE_PRICE_BOOK lists every model of the default routes and fallback chains (OpenRouter deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash, xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-flash and the Admin catalogue) with input/output micro-USD per token, source, checkedOn and verified; REFERENCE_PRICES_MICRO_PER_TOKEN and referencePrice keep their signatures; unverified prices are conservative and flagged.

model-router.ts: every generation span (legacy primary/fallback success, error, output safety block, format rejection; step chain success and error) records cost_micro, cost_source, price_verified, input_tokens, output_tokens; the root output records the total; routing and the 0.02 USD cap logic are unchanged and any change in when the cap triggers is documented.

Migration 20261115120000_ai_cost_by_feature_view.sql is idempotent, closed to anon/authenticated, exposes get_ai_cost_summary(days_back) only to ai.read or service_role, returns no user_id and no prompt/answer content.

Admin Tổng quan shows a 'Chi phí AI' table per feature for 7/14/30 days with 'ước tính' labels, 'chưa có lượt nào' when empty, the current budget (read only) and the line 'Giả định pilot Free: 1 USD/ngày (quyết định 15/11, chưa cấu hình)'.

Deno tests (prices, estimated/unknown, fallback/blocked traces), PGlite tests (percentiles, permissions, no raw user_id, re-run), admin:test (known CRLF Growth failure excepted after confirming on base), admin:check, validate-admin-contract, validate:backend, supabase:check, migration-ledger:check pass.
untouchedSurfaces: Routes, fallback order, provider switches, budget values (ai-usage-policy.json, ai_budget_campaigns) and the 0.02 USD cap constant are not changed.
Nil wallet, Nil price list, Daily/Tarot/Astrology functions (ai-tarot-reading, ai-astrology-insight, daily-attempts.ts), apps/mobile and PLAN.md are not touched.
Already-applied migrations are not edited; the trace tables keep their schema; no Edge Function or Admin deploy, no SQL applied.

impact.entryPoint: Admin › Tổng quan, card 'Chi phí AI' (7/14/30 ngày) for accounts with ai.read; backend: every Edge Function that calls generateWithModelRoute (persona chat, oracle, council, daily, tarot, astrology) writes richer spans after redeploy.
impact.dataWrite: No new table. Extra numeric/short enum attributes on existing ai_trace_spans rows and root_output of ai_trace_runs; the migration creates one view and one RPC, no rows.
impact.backendContract: public.get_ai_cost_summary(days_back integer default 7) returns jsonb; nilaza_private.ai_cost_calls view; provider-registry adds referencePriceInfo / callCost / projectCallCostMicro next to the unchanged referencePrice.
impact.adminVisibility: Aggregates only: counts, token sums, USD totals and percentiles per feature/model/day, estimated/unknown shares; budget shown read only; unverified prices flagged.
impact.privacySafety: Only technical span columns are read (tokens, cost, provider, model, status); no prompt or answer text; per-user distribution returns percentiles only and is hidden below 5 user-days; no user_id leaves the database.
impact.observability: cost_source shows how trustworthy each number is (reported from the OpenRouter receipt, estimated from tokens x reference price, unknown).
impact.rollback: drop function if exists public.get_ai_cost_summary(integer); drop view if exists nilaza_private.ai_cost_calls; revert the router/registry commit and redeploy the AI functions; Admin falls back to the 'Máy chủ chưa có hàm' note.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Record and --record preflight before the first edit; migration and deploys left to the Owner by hash; PGlite, Deno and jsdom tests only.

skillReview.name: nilaza-ai-runtime
skillReview.evidence: Router change is observability only: no route, fallback, prompt, safety or quota behavior change; traces stay redacted (numbers and snake_case enum strings).

dependencyReview.evidence: Model prices are volatile: taken from the public OpenRouter models API on 2026-11-15 and stored with source and date; no package added; PGlite loaded from the session scratchpad via NILAZA_PGLITE_MODULE.

externalSourceReview.reason: Public list prices (prompt/completion USD per token) for the OpenRouter models in the default routes and Admin catalogue

securityReview.authzRls: New RPC is security definer with empty search_path, checks service_role JWT claim or auth.uid() + has_capability('ai.read'); revoked from public/anon, execute granted to authenticated and service_role. The view is revoked from anon/authenticated and only selectable by service_role.
securityReview.sensitiveData: No user_id, prompt or answer text in the view or RPC output; per-user-day aggregates return only percentiles with a minimum group size of 5.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No secrets or env values read; trace attributes are numbers and short enums.
securityReview.externalInput: days_back is clamped to 1..90; attribute values are cast defensively (non-numeric -> null).
securityReview.dependencies: No dependency added to the repository.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Owner applies 20261115120000 by its LF SHA-256 and redeploys the AI Edge Functions and Admin; until then Admin shows that the server function is missing.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop if measuring cost would require changing routes, budgets, or exposing user ids or content.

workingTreeReview.note: Clean tree at start (worktree branch claude/nil-p1-cost-2026-11-15 at 3a624c7); this record and its --record preflight come before the first code edit.

validationCommands: npm run admin:test && npm run admin:check && node scripts/validate-admin-contract.mjs
npm run validate:backend && npm run supabase:check && npm run supabase:migration-ledger:check
managerTestPath: After the Owner applies the migration and redeploys the AI functions and Admin: use the app (chat, Tarot, Daily) a few times, open Admin › Tổng quan, card 'Chi phí AI': each feature shows lượt, tổng USD, trung vị/p95 mỗi lượt; press 14 or 30 ngày; rows marked 'ước tính' come from token x reference price; the budget and 'Giả định pilot Free: 1 USD/ngày' lines are visible.
residualRisk: Reference prices for OpenRouter models are the cheapest listed endpoint price on 15/11 and may differ from the endpoint OpenRouter actually routes to; the receipt (reported) wins when present. Direct DeepSeek prices are unverified and conservative. Old spans before redeploy only have charged_usd. Replay calls make no model call so they record no cost.
